# zlib interface headers

These unmodified zlib 1.3.2 headers were copied from the bundled Clang toolchain.
Their original copyright and license notices remain in each file. The native
client uses the standard inflate API already defined by the unchanged selected
driver archive; it does not call a private Mesa compression helper or add a codec
binary. The CPU-only shader roundtrip must qualify the native stream ABI before
any Vulkan use. Model weights and precision are unaffected.
